topic_ko: 이주와 식민 지배로 세계에 퍼진 영어가 사회의 필요에 따라 진화하며 수많은 변종, 즉 세계 영어(World Englishes)를 낳았다는 도입

passage: For centuries, English has served as a world language.
It traveled mainly with people who moved from Britain to lands like Australia, New Zealand, and North America.
In places such as India, Nigeria, and the Philippines, colonial rule also helped it spread.
Today there are so many varieties of English that nobody can count them, and each has its own features because a language changes to meet the different needs of the people who use it.
All these varieties together make up what we now call "World Englishes."
The term covers not only the English of Britain and the United States, where most people speak it as a first language, but also that of India, Singapore, and Kenya, where it is an official language.
It even includes the English of the Expanding Circle, a group of countries described by Braj Kachru.
In Korea, Mexico, and China, for example, English is learned mainly as a foreign language for international communication.
There, people whose mother tongues differ often turn to English to talk with one another.
choices: why English is the easiest language for foreigners to learn
how English spread and developed into the many varieties called World Englishes
the negative effects of colonial rule on local languages
the need for one fixed standard of English pronunciation
the number of English learners in each Expanding Circle country
theme.explanation_ko: 영어가 이주와 식민 지배로 퍼지고, 사회의 필요에 맞게 변하며 세계 영어라는 수많은 변종을 낳았다는 내용이므로 ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 배우기 쉬운 정도는 언급되지 않는다. ③ 식민 통치는 확산 경로 중 하나로만 나오고 그 해악은 다루지 않는다. ④ 글은 하나의 표준이 아니라 변종의 다양성을 인정한다. ⑤ 나라별 학습자 수는 제시되지 않는다.

order.given: World Englishes include not just the varieties of English spoken in countries like Britain and the United States where English is the first language of most people.

blocks.A: They include English varieties spoken in countries like Korea, Mexico, and China, where English is used primarily as a foreign language for international communication. In these Expanding Circle countries, English is often used for communication between speakers whose native languages are different.
blocks.B: They also include the varieties used in nations such as India, Singapore, and Kenya, in which English is an official language in education, business, and government.
blocks.C: Additionally, the term "World Englishes" covers varieties spoken in the Expanding Circle as described by Braj Kachru.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 not just 를 (B)의 also 가 이어받아 공용어 국가를 더하고, (C)의 Additionally 가 확장 원을 처음 소개한 뒤, (A)가 확장 원의 예와 쓰임을 설명하므로 ②이다.
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 these Expanding Circle countries 는 확장 원을 처음 소개하는 (C) 뒤에만 올 수 있고, (B)의 also 는 주어진 문장의 not just 와 짝을 이루므로 맨 앞에 와야 한다.
